newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai plans to build bicycle paths.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai plans to build bicycle paths.

text.p: Shanghai, home to more than 14 million people and six million bicycles, plans to build a cycling path along one of the city's busiest routes connecting its famous Bund to Zhongshan Park, Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
The first 3.34 km (1.74 miles) stretch of the network of cycling paths for the city will cost 280 million yuan ($34 million) and be completed this year, it said.
Shanghai, like Beijing, is known as a "bicycle kingdom," Xinhua said, but unlike the Chinese capital has no special bicycle paths.
Roads connecting the riverfront Bund and Zhongshan Park in the city's west are Shanghai's most congested, with cyclists having to run through a gauntlet of buses and cars on crowded streets, it said.
